author: CBR
description:
Nicolas Cage is playing Ben Reilly in Spider-Noir, not Peter Parker, and that’s a huge Spider-Man shake-up. 

In this Short, we break down why the Ben Reilly name matters: the 1970s Clone Saga, the Scarlet Spider connection, and the Jackal villain link that could still show up. Chris Miller even says the reason he’s named Ben Reilly will be explained. Here’s what that mystery is pointing to.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 18.
